tests.core_interrupt_model_scope: Actual core storage/setter/clear/USB reader extracted unchanged except insertion of simulated ISR reads between setter statements; one same-hart main writer, ISR reader. 147456 insertion points per configuration; not real USB timing or a multithread test.

target_code_review.writer: UsbBackend::stageButtons: eight report byte stores at 0x134..0x15c precede one byte store of keyboard_active at 0x164
target_code_review.reader: USB keyboard endpoint loads keyboard_active once at 0xc54, computes the selected slot and jumps to usb_send_data

usb_contract.startup: Neutral staged before USB start; each loop reads current SFC state and stages complete 8-byte keyboard report
usb_contract.coherence: Inactive slot filled, compiler barrier, volatile byte index publication; ISR snapshots index once and main cannot progress while ISR sends
usb_contract.six_key_policy: First six pressed buttons in bit order; recompute remaining held keys when a slot becomes available

limitations: Browser events do not identify the source device; SFC-only user procedure and confirmation associate events with this board.
Initial rollover trials did not preserve the intended baseline; recorded separately, not counted as recovery passes.
Coherent publication assumes one main-loop writer and same-hart USB ISR; no transfer acknowledgement or event queue added.
Short-pulse retention, boot-while-held, repeated reconnect, suspend/resume and iPhone/Delta operation not verified by these trials.
VDD/VCC, CLOCK/LATCH waveform, stack margin and enclosure installation not measured.
